outcome_evidence: The oven door is open at frame 0 in image and left_ego_image. The robot approaches and aligns with the door, then raises it toward the oven during frames 51–63. By frames 64–66 the door is upright and closed against the oven front; it remains closed as the gripper withdraws through frame 93 in image and left_ego_image. No failed attempt or unintended object displacement is visible.
